description.what: LP Support uses part of the trading fees to support a protocol-designated liquidity pool. This helps strengthen liquidity and support a more stable trading environment.
how: When trades occur, part of the allocated fees is accumulated.
Once the token reaches graduation, the accumulated fees are used to support the designated liquidity pool.
This helps improve liquidity depth and support a more stable trading environment.
rules: The allocated fees are used only for the protocol-designated liquidity pool.
Fees accumulated during the bonding curve are applied after graduation.
No manual claim or additional user action is required.
This does not directly distribute rewards to LP providers.
description.importantNote: LP Support helps strengthen liquidity and improve trading stability. It does not guarantee profits or price increases.
